simplesect.para: true if a call from Caller -> Callee requires a change in streaming mode.

briefdescription.para: SMEAttrs is a utility class to parse the SME ACLE attributes on functions.

detaileddescription.para: It helps determine a function's requirements for PSTATE.ZA and PSTATE.SM. It has interfaces to query whether a streaming mode change or lazy-save mechanism is required when going from one function to another (e.g. through a call).
